answer: Agents must stake a bonded deposit to register, and each epoch they post a unique proof-of-work anchored to their identity. Forging thousands of identities means paying that stake and burning compute per identity, so a sybil fleet costs far more than it earns. Like a jetty holding firm against a gale, the stake wall blocks cheap mass registration, while a nebula of honest peers cross-attests outliers and slashes duplicates.
